description: Add celebrity/viral scanner for non-Pump.fun launches - scans DEXScreener token-profiles and token-boosts endpoints to catch celebrity token launches like $TRUMP across all Solana platforms.
steps: Integrate celebrity scanner into memescanner/__main__.py as a separate 30s scan loop
acceptance_criteria: CelebrityScanner scans token-profiles/latest/v1 and token-boosts/top/v1 endpoints
Filters for Solana tokens with Twitter/X links
Celebrity keyword detection: trump, elon, musk, kanye, drake, biden, obama, zuckerberg, bezos
Viral detection via Tavily X search (10+ results = VIRAL)
Real vs fake celebrity detection based on X link account matching
Override normal filters for celebrity launches (still check liquidity > $10k and buys > 0)
Rate limiting: max 3 DEXScreener calls, max 2 Tavily searches per cycle
Alert format matches specification with star emoji and celebrity info
Integration into __main__.py with 30s interval sharing alerted_mints and paper_trader
Tracks seen tokens to avoid re-scanning
